_meta.description: Monster skill definitions. IDs referenced by monster_archetypes.json and monsters.json. Loaded by ContentLoader::load_monster_skills() at boot.
_meta.format_note: Same format as classes/{class}/skills.json — parsed by ContentLoader::parse_skill()
_meta.scaling_note: Monster skills scale via tier_multipliers in monster_skills_scaling.json, NOT percent_per_level
_meta.cast_time_note: cast_time field in seconds. 0 = instant. Interruptible if > 0. See monster_archetypes.json cast_time_system.

basic_skills.description_fr:
Morsure vicieuse qui déchire la chair.
Inflige 100% ATK dégâts physiques.
basic_skills.description_en:
A vicious bite that tears flesh.
Deals 100% ATK physical damage.

basic_skills.description_fr:
Frappe écrasante de tout le poids du corps.
Inflige 110% ATK dégâts physiques.
basic_skills.description_en:
A crushing blow with full body weight.
Deals 110% ATK physical damage.

basic_skills.description_fr:
Projectile lancé vers la cible.
Inflige 95% ATK dégâts physiques.
basic_skills.description_en:
A projectile hurled at the target.
Deals 95% ATK physical damage.

basic_skills.description_fr:
Coup tranchant rapide.
Inflige 105% ATK dégâts physiques.
basic_skills.description_en:
A swift slashing strike.
Deals 105% ATK physical damage.

pool.description_fr:
Frappe dévastatrice instantanée qui ébranle la cible.
Inflige 150% ATK dégâts physiques.
pool.description_en:
A devastating instant heavy strike that shakes the target.
Deals 150% ATK physical damage.

pool.description_fr:
Frappe en arc qui touche les ennemis adjacents et fait saigner.
Inflige 120% ATK dégâts physiques en zone. Applique Saignement (3s).
pool.description_en:
A sweeping arc that hits adjacent enemies and causes bleeding.
Deals 120% ATK physical damage in an area. Applies Bleed (3s).

pool.description_fr:
Charge en ligne droite, bousculant tout sur son passage.
Inflige 130% ATK dégâts physiques en colonne. Recul 1 case.
pool.description_en:
Charges forward in a line, knocking back everything in its path.
Deals 130% ATK physical damage in a column. Knockback 1 tile.

pool.description_fr:
Coup fatal sur une cible affaiblie. Dégâts doublés sous 30% HP.
Inflige 200% ATK dégâts physiques (x2 si cible < 30% HP).
pool.description_en:
A killing blow on a weakened target. Damage doubled below 30% HP.
Deals 200% ATK physical damage (x2 if target < 30% HP).

signature.description_fr:
Le brute martèle le sol, créant une onde de choc en croix.
Inflige 180% ATK dégâts physiques en croix. Renverse les cibles (2s).
signature.description_en:
The brute hammers the ground, creating a cross-shaped shockwave.
Deals 180% ATK physical damage in a cross pattern. Knocks down targets (2s).
